description: Keeps real third-party organisers out of the public repository, since they live only in the production database: fails when an Instagram, Facebook, Luma or Meetup URL in any tracked file, or an @handle in a fixture, story, test, doc, design pack, sample or demo file, names an account that is not on the fictional allowlist, and when committed generated listing data holds a record built from public sources. Findings print file, line and rule only, never the matched text.
